summary: The reply is mostly ready, but it should narrow one unsupported status claim and make the next step clearer before sending.

issues.finding: The draft says the issue has been resolved, but the supplied evidence only confirms that support reproduced the problem and opened an investigation.
issues.recommended_fix: Replace the resolution claim with a confirmed status update and a clear follow-up commitment that does not promise a fix date.

issues.finding: The next step says the team will check this, but it does not explain what evidence or update the customer can expect next.
issues.recommended_fix: State that support will review the reproduction details and update the customer once there is a confirmed next step.

issues.finding: The draft includes an unnecessary ticket ID in the customer-facing reply.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove the ticket ID from the customer-facing wording and keep it only in internal notes if needed.
